answer: The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the umber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the mirror re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
